title: NAS 5GS: update n1SmInfoFromUe and n1SmInfoToUe
description:
Update with handle expected TLV according to message type, and order
according to message format in TS 24.501 (not the order in TS 29.502)

notes.body: Maybe we could avoid the define for the unused codepoints
I'm okej remove them but nas_5gs_sm_message_type_vals will have a mix of defined and hex
Which seems ok to me as those are unused values anyway and won't be used anywhere else. I guess this is just a matter of taste, no strong opinion on my side.

I liked to have them in hex as it is easier to campare to tables in the
specifikation even if it's against programming practices.
